name: n8n_delete_workflow
description: Permanently delete an n8n workflow by ID (archive + remove). Gated: requires user confirmation unless auto-mode is on.
expected_effect: Permanently deletes the named workflow from the connected n8n instance. Cannot be undone — the workflow definition, history, and any active triggers are removed.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: ID of the workflow to delete
